title: UpToArmors
description: Upgrade your armor to higher tiers with improved durability and protection. Strengthen every armor set and unlock more powerful variants while keeping vanilla gameplay balance intact.
body:
## Armor Upgrade Mod

### Overview

This mod expands progression by allowing players to upgrade existing armor sets into stronger tiers. Instead of replacing vanilla equipment, it enhances it through structured crafting paths.

### Features

* Upgrade all standard armor types
* Increased durability and protection per tier
* Balanced progression system
* Fully compatible with vanilla mechanics

### Purpose

The goal of this project is to provide long-term equipment progression while preserving the core survival balance. Players can invest resources to strengthen their gear and improve survivability without breaking the original gameplay structure.
